title: RoleCard
description: A logical function. Roles bind to Sessions, never to Agents. No tool policy exists here, by design (C4).

can_write_code.description: May this role deliver code through channel B?

can_implement.description: May this role call hub.submit() as the implementer?

output_globs.description: Artifact paths this role may write through hub.put_artifact (channel C, non-code). Everything else — including every code path — is refused in code.

prompt.description: The role-card body injected at spawn and again at hub.hello().
